content.text:
The primary restoration flow works and focused tests/builds pass, but an asynchronous compatibility-cache event can replace a newly restored card with stale data. This breaks the patch's core result-restoration guarantee under a plausible event ordering.

Review comment:

- [P2] Ignore stale widget caches after a capability restore — /Users/burakemre/Code/lobu/.claude/worktrees/mcp-app-v8/packages/owletto/src/mcp-apps/_shared/host.tsx:860-863
  When a capability-only replay replaces an unkeyed card and `restore_lobu_app_result` succeeds, `resetForCapabilityResult` has set `hasLiveToolOutput` to false and the restore path never sets it back. A delayed `openai:set_globals` event containing only the previous `widgetState` therefore satisfies this condition and overwrites the exact restored data while retaining the new identity/view state. Treat successfully restored data as protected from widget-state-only fallback updates.
